notes: «حدثني هارون بن عبد الله، وحجاج بن الشاعر، قالا حدثنا حجاج بن محمد» joins the two teachers into one level.
«فقالت عائشة وغضبت» is Aisha speaking inside Jabir's account of the event: she is in the scene, not a source of the report, so Jabir stays the last link. The Prophet's reply is the saying.
